entities.name: Radomir Damnjanović Damnjan
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Radomir Damnjanović Damnjan was a Serbian-Italian painter and conceptual artist. Over a career spanning six decades, he explored and expanded traditional art forms, often questioning prevailing notions of creativity and authorship. His artistic practice encompassed a wide range of media, including painting, photography, video, and installation.
